description: Statuses the live API returns but the spec does not declare (observed 2026-09-29): GET /v2/databases/{db_id} answers 404 {"error":"The database has not been found."} for an unknown or deleted id, and POST /v2/databases answers 400 {"error":"invalid request","details":...} for a name that is not a slug or a region outside the enum. (PATCH, DELETE and token generation answer 500 for an unknown id, so callers decide 'gone' with GET.)
